name: dsh-ros2-sidecar
description: dsh-ros2 data-plane sidecar framework (逻辑直连·物理分离). An independent process that subscribes high-frequency ROS2 topics, reduces them to semantic cache entries (value for logic / text for the LLM), and serves the control plane over a Unix Domain Socket. The concrete reducers (obstacle boolean, cup pose TF) are by-design NOT implemented — this ships the template framework only. Not a cordis bundle.
